page.layout: One column of running text in the centre of the page; the running head above it; the catchword at the lower right. No notes in either margin.

main_text.p: Ex manifesto nascuntur feminæ quædam, quæ unam tantum sui ortus & generationis habent rationem: quædam vero pluribus modis propagantur.

Quæ uno modo pronascuntur, è fo-lo nascuntur feminæ & quidem hoc modo: Semen in terram humidam incidens emollitur, & calore tum naturali tum cœlesti fovetur & intumescens propter humore illi a terra influente rumpitur: Eaque parte, qua jam ruptum est, germen enascitur, molle quidem & tenue principio, sed tamen postea firmius ac crassius redditur: Cujus pars una æ-reæ naturæ particeps ascendit sursum: altera vero quia terrestris & crassa in terris residens coalescit.

Ortum deinde plantæ fovet humor calore decoctus & ab interna ipsorū natura attract[?]: Et quæ succo plus affluunt, earum quoq; incrementum est & majus & celerius: Quæ tamen in incremento varietas potius ex forma dependet.
Tempus autem ortus non omnibus plantis est unum & idem, sed varium, quædam citius, quædam tardius pronascuntur.

page.notes: The first letter of "Tempus" is a decorative initial. "attract[?]": the final letter is a superscript abbreviation mark, read as p. "è fo-lo": the hyphen is printed at the line end. The first line and the last line are set in a full column, so no paragraph breaks there are doubtful.
